caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher with a wide spout and a looped handle. The pitcher is predominantly brown with various shades, and features intricate decorative motifs. Around the body of the pitcher, there are raised reliefs depicting a woodland scene with trees, foliage, and small animals such as a stag and a dog. The upper section of the pitcher near the mouth has detailed patterns of leaves and possibly berries or grapes. The handle has a ribbed texture and curves from the top rim to the shoulder of the pitcher. The pitcher sits on a small, flat base and is centered on a blank, light beige background. There is a small linear scale and a signature "chas. Oseau" on the lower margin of the drawing.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
